know, this is what's so interesting about 150 years. USDA being in existence. When Lincoln founded USDA, his whole idea was, look, we've got farmers out there who need the best technology. We need to put in their hands the ability to be more productive and to feed their families and to feed others. You know what? USDA is not really straight from that mission. That's the remarkable thing about this. If you look at the core mission of USDA, what did we do when I was there and have continued to do, and we've done for 150 years, we got good information in the hands of farmers. We encourage things like research and market promotion to make it more possible for them to feed the world, and that mission continues today.
